title: Hotspawn CS2 coverage, TWC Day 5 and scoped Privateer market audit
policy: Hotspawn supplies the fixture inventory only; Hotspawn popularity/pick percentages and HLTV fan polls are not probability inputs.
Use fresh paired external match-winner books or explicitly labeled research models. Do not turn map, handicap, outright, directory or community prices into a match-winner probability.
Leave probabilities blank when evidence fails identity, freshness, prematch, or the published 0.12 maximum-spread gate. Preserve the source and reason.
Match results and roster history are context, not automatic probability adjustments.

aurora_roster_context.reported_change: HLTV reports kyxsan, Jimpphat and coach ash joining Aurora, replacing MAJ3R, soulfly and coach Fabre.
aurora_roster_context.interpretation: The July rebuild and Day-1 lineup are confirmed historical context. Aurora then beat NiP and 9z before losing to FURIA. Four event series cannot establish a causal onboarding effect or a predictive adjustment; no roster penalty/bonus is applied to either Day-5 market estimate. The Day-5 match-day five is not independently confirmed by this historical report.

irregularities_and_caveats: The session-start 22:53 UTC origin snapshot had 6 unresolved matches, including ex-6666–Privateer. Production run 39083401681 later published a 00:42 UTC snapshot with 34 active / 27 with picks / 7 unresolved; the later count is separately recorded above and was still subject to open PRs 90 and 91.
Polymarket's ex-6666–Privateer book is single-source and shallow, and its market page displayed $0 traded volume; any accepted probability is indicative, not executable.
Some esportsbook pages returned 403 or generic landing pages in the published research. Those failures are reported as unavailable, never treated as proof that no market exists.

The initial session-start TWC card had Hotspawn entry/lock unverified. By production run 39083401681, the weekly Hotspawn feed listed exact Aurora–Falcons and FURIA–BETBOOM fixtures with open pick locks; this proves weekly fixture presence, not separate tournament registration or a submitted pick.
The site has separate base-feed and extended-originated coverage counts by design; use the correct page and scope when quoting totals.

published_copy_correction.status: Corrected in this branch; publication awaits PR merge and Pages verification.
issues_found: The prior Day-5 narrative mislabeled the Day-3 Aurora/9z 69.5%/30.5% quote as a Day-1 price; the Day-1 prematch price was not captured and remains — unverified.
The Day-1 prose said 9z conceded one Nuke round; HLTV records Aurora scoring one round on Aurora's Nuke pick (13-1).

Several prose lines called the July Aurora rebuild freshly onboarded in October and asserted onboarding effects faded, or claimed Aurora won three straight group series after Day 1. The results do not establish that cause/time course, and Aurora won two group series after the opener.
